units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:2">Eduy. II, 2</cite> <he>לא ראינו אין ר׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>אין לא ראינו ר׳</he>) ‘we have not seen’ is no evidence (that an act did not take place); <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 12:4">Zeb. XII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 23a:5">Keth. 23ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 15b:9">Ib. 15ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>אייתי ר׳ דישראל את</he> produce evidence that thou art an Israelite.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:8">Snh. III, 8</cite> <he>כל זמן שמביא ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O01713"><he>סָתַר</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:11">B. Kam. III, 11</cite>, a. fr. <he>עליו הר׳</he> it rests on him to produce evidence, v. <cite ref="J00515"><he>יָצָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 154a:1">B. Bath. 154ᵃ</cite> top <he>ר׳ במאי</he> wherein must his evidence consist? <he>ר׳ בעדים</he> evidence by producing witnesses; <he>ר׳ בקיום השטר</he> evidence by which the document is identified.
<cite ref="Pesachim 15a">Pes. 15ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין הנדון דומה לר׳</he> the case under discussion is not parallel to the evidence (the case which you cite is not analogous).

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:8">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אע״פ שאין ר׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00469"><he>זֵכֶר</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רַאֲיוֹת</he>. Snh. l. c. <he>כל ר׳ שיש לך וכ׳</he> whatever new evidences you may have, you must produce within thirty days.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:2:4">Y. Shebu. VI, 37ᵃ</cite> top <he>בכופר ברַאֲיוֹתָיו̇</he> when the opponent contests his evidence.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="E00525"><he>הַכְרָעָה</he></cite>; a. e.
